name: Empathrem
biography: Psiocladia galera. A hovering aberrant empath that reads every heart around it and pummels anyone whose emotions run too hot — rage, in particular, is answered with immediate violence. Habitat: The Low.

features.name: Magical Empath
features.description:
The empathrem is always under the effects of the Detect Thoughts and Detect Emotion* spells, both of which detect creatures out to a range of 120 feet.

*See the Spells page of the Field Notes PDF.

features.name: Telepathic Shroud
features.description: The empathrem's thoughts can't be read by any means, and magic can't detect its location or observe it remotely.

features.name: Violent Suppression
features.description: The empathrem reacts aggressively to nearby creatures that don't keep their emotions in check. Saving Throw: DC 15 Wisdom, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from the empathrem at the start of each of the empathrem's turns. A creature that is unaware of the empathrem's presence makes the saving throw with Disadvantage, and a creature under the effects of the Calm Emotions spell makes it with Advantage. A creature in a Rage loses Immunity to this effect and automatically fails saving throws against it. Failure: The empathrem has Advantage on attack rolls against the target for 1 minute, and the target automatically fails the saving throws against other empathrems' Violent Suppression traits for 1 hour. Success: The target is Immune to the effects of any empathrem's Violent Suppression for 1 hour.

features.name: Pummel
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. A target hit by two Pummel attacks on the same turn has its Speed halved and can't speak until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Panic
features.description: Trigger: The empathrem takes Psychic damage. Response: The empathrem makes one Pummel attack against a creature within reach and moves up to its Speed away from the source of the damage.
